visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An elderly man with glasses peeks his head out from behind a wooden door, looking into a room with a curious and slightly mischievous expression. In the foreground, a white thermos sits on a wooden shelf covered with a white decorative mesh cloth. The room is brightly lit with indoor light. (2) The camera pans to the right to reveal an orange and white tabby cat lounging comfortably on a person's legs, which are covered in gray trousers. The cat is focused on grooming its back left leg, spreading its pink paw pads wide and licking them repeatedly. (3) The man at the door continues to watch the cat, his face partially obscured by the white door frame. He smiles and speaks toward the cat. The camera cuts back to the cat, which remains completely indifferent to the man's presence, continuing its meticulous grooming routine on the bed. (4) The cat looks briefly towards the camera or the door but then immediately turns away to lick its fur, showing no interest. Yellow subtitles and variety-show style text overlays appear on the screen, punctuating the interaction. The person holding the cat remains mostly out of frame except for their legs and feet.
